scores.notes: Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, lean build, dark brown cloak over a pale tunic; left on the shore, right seated on the stone.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and a slim build in a short brown tunic; the right figure is smaller but the cues are readable.
Moses in both is an elderly man with white swept-back hair, a full white beard, weathered tan face and dark brown cloak over a cream tunic; hair is slightly longer on the right but no cue conflicts.

Daniel in both is a lean older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin, in a dark blue fringed robe over a pale tunic with a scroll case at his hip; left is small in the pit but the cues are readable.

Both show a night sea under heavy dark cloud with green-teal water drawn back on either side of a brown muddy seabed path and rocky hills beyond; left views it from the shore, right from inside the corridor, which is a compatible change of viewpoint.

Moses in both is an old lean man with white hair, a full white beard and weathered face, wearing a brown cloak over a cream tunic with a staff; hair is a little longer on the right but nothing conflicts.
Peter (left foreground by the brazier; right standing on the boat's bow) has the same grey-flecked dark curly hair, short grey beard, tanned middle-aged face and brown cloak over a cream tunic.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic (left kneeling under the oil, right dodging the spear).

Both show a circular pit lined with pale grey stone blocks sunk in sandy ground in pale early light, with a stone wall and steps beside it; the right adds a low parapet and palms but the layout is compatible from a different viewpoint.

Moses in both is an old man with white swept-back hair, a full white beard and tanned face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a crook staff; hair is a bit longer on the right but nothing conflicts.

On the left Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop, with no readable face, hair or beard, so he cannot be compared with the long-haired bearded man standing in the boat on the right.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and lean build in a rough brown tunic with a pouch; his head is bowed on the left but hair, age and build match.

Both show the same kind of single-masted wooden fishing boat on open water with a hilly shore carrying a small village; the left is the calm with clearing twilight sky and the right the dark moonlit storm, a change the passages themselves ask for.

Left Peter has dark curly salt-and-pepper hair and a grizzled beard on a middle-aged face; the man diving from the boat on the right has pale grey-white, thinner hair and a white beard and reads clearly older.

Both show a night sea under broken storm cloud with a moon, blue-green water piled back from a tan sandy seabed path, and tawny cliffs with a walled town on the far right shore; left is from inside the corridor, right from the beach.

Both show a corridor of seabed between towering green-teal walls of water under a dark night sky, with a rocky outcrop and low hills closing the far end; the ground is darker and muddier on the left and the left wall paler, but the place is compatible.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier; right the man with the net over his shoulder gripping the lame man's hand) has curly dark greying hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and brown cloak in both; he is smaller and a little darker-haired on the right but no cue conflicts.

Daniel (left, the man being hauled out of the pit; right, foreground looking up) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard in a dark blue fringed robe over a pale tunic with a scroll case; skin reads darker in the right night scene but hair, beard, age and build match.

Peter (left standing on the bow reaching out; right the central man with the net over his shoulder and a staff) has curly dark greying hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and sturdy build in a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and the same cream tunic with blue mantle in both; on the right he is small and at the top edge on the cross, but hair and beard are visible and agree.

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a cream tunic under a dark brown mantle in both; on the right he is the staff-bearing elder at the front of the crowd (a second similar elder stands beside him).

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic, dark brown mantle and staff in both; left he is seen partly from behind with slightly longer hair, but age, hair and beard colour agree.
Moses is an old man with long white hair, a long white beard and a dark mantle over a pale tunic in both; on the right he is a small figure with a staff at the edge of the column, still legible.

Left Daniel has close-cropped grey hair, a short clipped grey beard and dark brown skin; right Daniel has fuller, wavy, collar-length grey hair swept back, lighter skin and a different, longer face. Robe and satchel match but hair length and skin tone conflict.

Both show a pale-dawn pebble shore of a calm lake ringed by terraced tan hills with cypress, palms and a small flat-roofed village on the far bank; the fire is only in the left view, but land, water and vegetation agree.
Daniel is an older lean man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, in the same dark blue fringed robe with satchel; he is small in the pit on the right but legible.

Jesus has long dark brown hair past the shoulders, a short dark beard, a cream tunic and a blue-grey mantle in both; he is a small distant figure on the water left, but hair, beard and build are visible and agree.
Peter is a sturdy middle-aged man with short curly dark-grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a rough brown coat over a pale tunic in both, standing on the prow left and diving right.

Left Jesus is a tiny haloed figure far off on the water whose face cannot be read; only dark long hair, a cream tunic and blue mantle show, which agree with the right-hand Jesus but are too little to judge identity (a second similar long-haired man also stands in the boat's stern).

Left Peter (centre, net over his shoulders) is a man in his forties with thick dark curly hair and a dark beard; the right-hand Peter diving from the boat is an elderly man with thin white-grey hair and a white beard. Hair colour and apparent age conflict.

Jesus is a small figure at the top edge on the cross left and a tiny distant haloed figure on the water right; long dark hair and a cream tunic with blue mantle agree, but the right-hand face is too small to judge identity.

Left Jesus is clear (long dark hair, dark beard, cream tunic, blue-grey mantle) but right Jesus is a tiny haloed figure far out on the water whose face cannot be read; clothing and dark hair agree, yet too little shows to judge identity.
David is a lean clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and a rough brown tunic in both, crouched at the brook left and dodging the spear in firelight right.

Both are dark, cloud-heavy night scenes of a sandy seabed path between dark green heaped-up waves, with a rocky cliffed coast behind; the left looks back at the walkers under a moon, the right looks out from the shore along the path, a compatible change of viewpoint.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a rough brown tunic with shoulder bag in both; small while slinging on the left, close up on the right.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a brown tunic in both; he looks a little younger and smaller in the left scene, but hair, skin tone and face type agree.

Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, a dark mantle over a pale tunic and a crook staff in both; he is a small figure at the right edge of the right image but hair and beard are legible.

Daniel is an older man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both (standing before the king on the left, standing among lions in the pit on the right); the blue-over-white robe also matches.

Peter (central man with staff and net on the left; man leaping from the boat on the right) has the same curly greying dark hair, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, with a brown mantle and net over the shoulder.

David (slinger on the left; boy dodging the spear on the right) is a beardless teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in both, wearing a short brown tunic; the left figure is small but the cues agree.

Both show a wet sandy seabed corridor receding between two towering teal water walls under a dark storm-cloud sky (night/moonlit in both); the right shows more rocky hills at the far end but the corridor, walls and lighting are compatible.

Peter (the man clasping the beggar's hand on the left; large foreground figure on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, with a rough brown mantle. (The net is carried by the companion on the left, but that is an accessory.)

Both Daniels are grey-bearded men in the same blue fringed robe, but the left (being hauled from the pit) has close-cropped grey hair, a rounder older face and darker tan skin, while the right (foreground) has full wavy collar-length grey hair swept back, a longer narrower and younger-looking face and paler skin; hair length/style and face shape conflict.

Left Daniel (foreground) has full wavy collar-length grey hair swept back, a long narrow face and paler skin; right Daniel (small, in the pit among lions) has close-cropped/receding grey hair, a rounder older face and darker skin. Both have short grey beards and the same blue robe, but hair length/style and face conflict.

David (dodging the spear on the left; kneeling to be anointed on the right) is a beardless teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in both, in a rough brown tunic; the right head is bowed so the face is partly hidden, but hair, age and build agree.

Both show the same open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, tattered pale sail and a lit lantern hung at the mast, on a dark lake with hilly shores under heavy cloud in dim light; the right is calmer, a bit brighter (twilight glow vs moonlit night) and shows the shore villages closer, which fits a different viewpoint and the asked-for calm.

Both show a calm, mist-hung lake at early-morning light with hazy rolling hills and a low earthy shore, the same wooden boat and nets; the left sees the shore from the water at a distance and the right stands on it (with a village and palms further along), which are compatible viewpoints.

Both show a small open wooden fishing boat with a single mast swamped by steep dark waves at night, with the moon breaking through storm cloud in the same position; the left includes a hilly village shore and other boats that the tighter right view omits, and the sail is furled left and set right, but the place and occasion are compatible.

Moses (raising the rod by the rock on the left; smaller figure with crook at right of the crowd on the right) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in both, with cream tunic and dark brown mantle; the right figure is small and dimly lit but hair, beard, age and build agree.

Daniel (looking up at the vision on the left; pointing at the wall on the right) is an older lean man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both, with a blue fringed mantle over cream; hair and beard read a little whiter on the smaller left figure and more salt-and-pepper on the right, but length, style, age and face agree.

Moses (large foreground figure with staff on the left; the staff-bearing man at the centre-front of the crowd on the right) is an old man with white swept-back hair, full white beard and tan skin in both, in cream tunic and brown mantle. The right figure is small and a near-identical white-bearded man walks beside him, but the one with the staff matches.

Both show a small open wooden boat with a single bare mast and a lit lantern on a black, heaving lake at night, with the moon behind storm cloud at upper left and a low dark hilly shore on the horizon; viewpoint differs (close on deck vs side-on) but boat, water, sky and time match.
Peter stepping off the boat (left) and in the courtyard foreground (right): both middle-aged with dark curly hair greying at the temples, short grizzled beard, tanned skin and stocky build.
Daniel hauled from the pit (left) and pointing before the king (right): both an older lean man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same blue fringed robe and scroll case.

Peter diving from the boat (left, face seen in profile from above) and in the courtyard foreground (right): both have short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and stocky build; no conflicting cue, though the left face is small.

Moses striking the rock (left) and seated on the stone with arms held up (right): both an aged man with wavy white hair to the collar, full white beard, weathered tan skin and the same brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Peter standing at the bow with a net on his shoulder (left) and the front figure with the net by the fire (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair flecked grey, short greying beard, tan skin and sturdy build.
Peter grasping the lame man's hand (left) and stepping off the boat (right): both have short curly dark hair going grey, a short grizzled beard, tanned skin and a stocky build.

Both show a hillside of olive trees and pale stone houses sloping down to a lake with moored boats on the right, a white landmark building above the village and a dirt track by low stone walls; viewpoint differs (close by the house vs. on the road).

David kneeling by the brook (left) and kneeling under the oil horn (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same ragged brown tunic; right face is bowed but hair, age and build match.

Both show a single-masted wooden fishing boat with a hanging lantern on a dark heaving sea under a moon half-hidden by storm cloud, with a low hilly shoreline in the distance; right is just a closer view of the stern.

Daniel pointing in the hall (left) and standing roped in the pit (right, small but face visible): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same blue fringed mantle and scroll case.

Peter with net and staff clasping the lame man's hand (left) and the front man with staff and net by the fire (right): both have short curly dark hair greying, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and sturdy build.

Moses seated with arms held up (left) and raising the staff at the rock (right): both an aged man with white hair, long full white beard, weathered tan skin and the same pale tunic with dark brown cloak.

Moses seated between the two helpers (left) and standing with staff before the parting sea (right, in profile from behind): both an old man with collar-length white hair and a full white beard, same brown cloak over pale tunic.

David dodging the spear (left) and kneeling at the brook (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in a plain brown tunic; left reads slightly younger but no cue conflicts.

Daniel watching the fiery thrones (left) and standing roped in the pit (right, small): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic.

Moses with arms spread before the parted sea (left, in profile from behind) and seated with raised arms (right): both an old man with collar-length white hair and a full white beard, pale tunic and dark brown cloak.

David after the sling throw (left, small) and kneeling under the oil horn (right, head bowed): both a slim clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a short brown tunic; faces are small/bowed but hair, age and build agree with no conflict.

Peter with net and staff lifting the lame man (left) and front figure with net by the fire (right): both middle-aged with short curly dark hair greying, a short grizzled beard and sturdy build; left hair is a little greyer and skin a little lighter, but not a clear conflict.

Moses raising the staff at the rock (left) and with arms spread before the sea (right, profile from behind): both an old man with thinning white hair to the collar and a long white beard, same pale tunic and dark brown cloak.

Peter standing with a net at left of the courtyard (left) and standing on the bow (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair, short greying beard, tan-brown skin and sturdy build; right hair shows a bit more grey but no clear conflict.

Peter standing with a net at left of the courtyard (left) and with net and staff lifting the lame man (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair, short greying beard, tan-brown skin and sturdy build; right is a little greyer, not a clear conflict.

Right image clearly shows Peter (grey-flecked dark curly hair, short beard, darker skin) lifting the lame man, but the left shows a row of similar dark-bearded men round the fire with none singled out as Peter.

Both show the same kind of open wooden single-masted fishing boat with a lit lantern hanging from the mast on a grey sea under storm cloud; the left is the dark storm and the right the clearing calm with a far shore, which is the change the passages ask for.
Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded old man with a tall staff and dark-brown mantle over a pale robe in both, walking ahead of the crowd at left and seated on the rock at right.
Jesus has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short full beard, slim build and blue-grey mantle over a pale robe in both, standing in the boat at left and before the tomb at right.
Both show a muddy seabed corridor between towering dark-teal water walls at night under heavy cloud, with a hill town on the far shore; left looks along the path, right looks at it from the shore.

Peter diving at left and Peter stepping on the water at right both have short dark curly hair, a short full beard, tanned skin and a stocky build; the right looks a little greyer under the night light but no cue clearly conflicts.
Jesus on the cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, matching the long dark-haired bearded man in the same blue mantle at the tomb.
Moses is small at left but clearly a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark-brown mantle over a pale robe, matching the white-haired bearded man raising the crook at the rock.

Peter standing at the bow at left and Peter lifting the lame man at right share grey-flecked short curly hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build, with a net slung on the shoulder in both.
Jesus at the tomb and the small figure standing on the water both have long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe; small at right but no cue conflicts.

Moses at left is a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark-brown mantle; at right he is seen in back-three-quarter profile but shows the same long white hair, white beard, crook and dark mantle.
Jesus standing in the boat at left and the small figure on the water at right both have long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard, slim build and a blue-grey mantle over a pale robe.

David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in both, kneeling to be anointed at left and slinging at right (smaller there), in a short brown tunic with a pouch.

Right shows Peter large and clear (dark curly greying hair, greying beard, net on shoulder), but the left is a row of ten similar dark-bearded men round the fire and nothing singles out which one is Peter.
Moses is small at left but clearly a white-haired, white-bearded elder with a crook and dark mantle, matching the white-haired, white-bearded man with the crook beside the priest at right.
Daniel standing in the pit has short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, brown skin and a slim build in both, with the same dark-blue mantle over a pale robe and a belt pouch.
David is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in both, slinging at left (smaller) and kneeling at the brook at right, in a ragged brown tunic.
Jesus has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short full beard, slim build and blue mantle over a pale robe in both, pointing at the tomb at left and standing in the boat at right.

Jesus is small in both but shows long dark shoulder-length hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe both standing on the water at left and on the central cross at right; no cue conflicts.
Peter standing by the brazier at left has dark brown hair and a dark beard; the man diving from the boat at right has clearly grey-white hair and a grey beard and looks markedly older.
Peter in the left foreground and the prominent front man with net and staff on the shore at right share short dark curly hair going grey, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build.

Jesus on the cross (left, small at the top edge) and standing in the boat (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and slim build; left face is small but no cue conflicts.
Both show a brown muddy seabed path between parted dark teal water under a dark stormy sky with rocky headlands at the shore; left from the shore as it opens, right from inside with high walls.
Jesus (left small, standing on the water; right standing in the stern) has the same shoulder-length dark hair, dark beard and slim build in both.
Moses is an elderly man with white hair and a long white beard, lean build and a crook staff in both (left walking the seabed, right in profile on the rock).
David (left kneeling under the oil, right slinging) is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, tanned skin and rough brown tunic in both; right is small but consistent.
Both show a wooden single-mast fishing boat with a lantern on a dark night sea under heavy cloud with a moon and a hilly shore; the sea calming on the right is the change the descriptions ask for.

Peter (left foreground with a net over his shoulder, right second from left with the net) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard and sturdy build in both; skin is somewhat darker on the right but face and hair match.
Jesus is clear on the left (long dark hair, beard, by the tomb) but on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the hilltop cross with no readable face or hair.

Left Peter (standing on the prow) has thick dark curly hair with a dark greying beard and looks about fifty; right Peter (diving) has thin receding grey-white hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older.

Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees, tan hills and a lake on the horizon under a warm golden sky; the house is tan mud-brick at a distance on the left and rough stone up close on the right, with a white columned building only on the right, but the layout is compatible.
Daniel (left small among the lions, right hauled up on the rope) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a blue robe over white in both.

Both show the same dark muddy rock-strewn seabed corridor between towering teal-green water walls at night with a moon in heavy cloud and rocky heights at the far end; a walled town on the right-hand height appears only on the right but does not conflict.

Daniel (left on the rope, right pointing before the king) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, lean face and blue fringed robe with scroll case in both; skin reads darker in the torchlit hall but features match.
Moses (left in profile with raised arms and crook, right front-centre holding the staff) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in a dark cloak over a pale tunic in both.
Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right leaping from the boat) has short dark curly hair flecked with grey, a short greying beard and a weathered tanned face in both.

Moses (left striking the rock, right standing with the crook beside the priest) is an old man with white hair and a full white beard, tanned lined face, in a dark brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Moses (left gazing up with the crook, right raising the crook at the rock) is an old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard, lined tanned face, in a brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
Daniel (left small, standing among the lions; right being hauled up by ropes) has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tanned skin and a blue fringed robe over white in both.

Jesus (left standing in the boat, right small on the central cross) has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard and slim build in both; the right figure is small but hair and beard are readable and nothing conflicts.

Right Peter is clear (curly greying hair, grey-flecked beard, stepping off the boat) but the left shows eleven small near-identical dark-bearded men round the fire with nothing that singles out Peter, so there is no figure to compare.

Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees and a hillside town of pale flat-roofed houses with the same white columned building, with the lake beyond under a soft warm sky; left is the road, right the house terrace.
Both show a calm pale-dawn lake shore with a flat-roofed stone village at the water's edge, hazy hills behind and a small coal fire on the beach; right adds palms but the layout is compatible.
Both show the same wooden boat with a mast lantern on a dark night sea, a hilly shore with a small village on the left horizon and a moon breaking through storm cloud.

Peter is the man diving from the boat on the left and the man gripping the beggar's hand on the right; both have short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tan skin and a sturdy build, though the diver's face is small and angled down and the right shows a little more grey.

Moses (foreground with staff on the left, striking the rock on the right) is an elderly tan-skinned man with white hair and white beard in both; hair and beard are somewhat longer on the right but age, colouring and build agree.

Left is a narrow lake at pale twilight with village-dotted hillsides close on both sides; right is open water in deep moonlit night with lightning, other boats and only distant dark headlands, so the time of day and shoreline do not match beyond the storm/calm change.
David (crouching at the brook on the left, kneeling to be anointed on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, ruddy fair skin and slim build.

Peter is clearly the dark-curly-haired bearded man diving on the left, but on the right ten near-identical dark-haired bearded men stand round the fire at a distance and nothing reliably singles out which one is Peter.
Moses (arm raised at the sea on the left, foreground with staff on the right) is an elderly man with white swept-back hair, full white beard and tan weathered face in both.
Moses (foreground with staff on the left, the staff-bearer at the right of the column on the right) has white hair, a full white beard and elderly build in both, though he is small on the right.

Left looks from the beach at the sea starting to split under a dark stormy night sky; right is inside the corridor between the same blue-green wave-walls on wet sand under the same dark storm sky, a compatible closer view.
David (kneeling under the oil on the left, dodging the spear on the right) is the same clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, light tan skin and slim build in a brown tunic.

David (the sling-holder standing behind fallen Goliath on the left, dodging the spear on the right) is a clean-shaven slim youth with short dark hair and the same skin tone in both, though small on the left.
Peter (stepping off the bow on the left, the net-draped man clasping the beggar's hand on the right) has short dark curly hair, a short greying dark beard, tan skin and a sturdy build in both.
Both show the same round ashlar-lined open pit set in sandy ground with a barred grate under a wooden hatch on its rim and palms behind, in grey early light.
Jesus (gesturing at the tomb on the left, standing in the stern on the right) has the same long dark-brown shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, tan skin and slim build.
David (crouching at the brook on the left, the slinger behind fallen Goliath on the right) is a clean-shaven slim youth with short black curly hair and tan skin in both, though small on the right.

Jesus on the left is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop, face and hair not legible; on the right he is a small long-haired bearded figure on the water. Too small on the left to judge identity.

Daniel (left foreground looking up; right standing among the lions) is an older lean man with short grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both, wearing the same blue mantle over a cream robe with a shoulder satchel.

Peter (left the net-carrying man clasping the beggar's hand; right the man leaping from the boat) has dark curly greying hair, a short dark-grey beard, tan skin and the same brown robe with a net over the shoulder in both.

Daniel (left standing among the lions; right foreground looking at the sky) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean older build in both, with the same blue mantle over a cream robe.

Moses (left seated on the stone with arms raised; right raising the staff at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan weathered face in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is a little longer on the left.

Moses (left seated on the rock with arms held up; right standing with a staff beside the priest) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan lined face in both, in a dark brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is fuller on the left and thinner on top on the right, but age, beard and face agree.

Daniel (left pointing before the king; right foreground looking up at the sky) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, lean older face and tan skin in both, with the same blue mantle, pale robe and cylindrical shoulder case.

Moses (left seen in profile from behind stretching his staff over the sea; right swinging the staff at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair and a long white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; the left face is in part-profile but hair, beard and age agree.

Both show the same open circular pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks with a sandy floor and a flat stone rim on bare dry ground under a pale sky; the left also shows a barred gate, steps and a compound wall with palms on its far side while the right looks out over open ground, which opposite viewpoints could explain.

Moses (left the white-haired man with the staff at the front centre of the crowd; right raising the crook at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; a second similar elder stands beside him on the left but the staff singles him out.
